_about: Frozen 2026-10-21 before any head was sculpted. Verbatim or near-verbatim fragments of design/CAST-SHEETS.md, design/ART-DIRECTION.md section 4 and design/CHARACTERS-ART.md section 3. 'face' keeps only what the sheets say about the head, face, hair and age; 'full' is the whole entry as a player-facing description (costume, props and face). Used by characters/heads-test/PROTOCOL.md tasks B and C.

lamb.face: A beak on a stalk: a two-segment hooked nose, a long chin, bulging heavy-lidded eyes. Forehead creases, stubble, sallow skin. A long neck that shows between the collar and the jaw.
lamb.full: The assessor. A wide soft hat brim tipped back; a slate greatcoat with an oxblood lining and a pale open collar; a claims case on the hip on a diagonal strap; a lantern. Face: a long hooked nose, heavy lids, a long chin; a long neck.

keel.face: A tall egg of a head, a long jaw, a tiny down-turned mouth. Long grey face 'of a thumb kept in a bath': waterlogged skin with vertical prune wrinkles, eyes pale and wet, grey sideburns. No visible neck.
keel.full: The harbourmaster. A navy greatcoat black with wet, buttoned to the throat with a standing collar; a peaked cap with a white badge; a brass speaking trumpet under the arm. Face: long and grey, long jaw, small mouth, pale wet eyes, grey sideburns.

sabine.face: A wide loaf of a head, apple cheeks, a grin to the ears, small bright eyes like currants, broad cheeks. Dark hair in a bun. No visible neck: the head sits down in the shoulders.
sabine.full: Sleeves rolled to the elbow, a striped apron over a dark skirt, a shawl crossed and tied behind; a pickling fork through the bun. Face: a wide mouth with a ready smile, small bright eyes, broad cheeks; dark hair in a bun.

wenna.face: An oversized head. Small nose, deep lines, heavy lids, a thin set mouth. White hair cropped short, cut with a knife, uneven.
wenna.full: The keeper of Mother. An oxblood keeper's coat, too long, cuffs turned back, over a grey knitted gansey; a brass key on a string at her neck. An oversized head with a white crop cut with a knife; small nose, deep lines, heavy lids, thin set mouth.

penhallow.face: A square woman. Grey hair. A square face.
penhallow.full: A square woman, master of a barge: a master's reefer jacket over a skirt, a peaked cap with grey hair below it, a pale muffler, a cold clay pipe in her teeth, a log book.

gorm.face: A woman, a sergeant. Face: square, still, eyebrows raised.
gorm.full: A lamplighter sergeant: a long dark Municipal coat, a cap with a brass badge and a pale band, a short braided cape, an open book held in her left hand, a brass pole. Face: square, still, eyebrows raised.

hobb.face: The youngest, eighteen. Face: long and anxious.
hobb.full: The youngest lamplighter: a long dark Municipal coat too big at the shoulder, bare-headed, two lit lanterns held out from the body, the pole slung on his back. Face: long and anxious.

marrow.face: A large man of forty-five. A broad nose, a heavy brow and heavy lids, jowls, a dark beard shadow.
marrow.full: The Guild steward: vast, a blue smock with a long white stained apron, sleeves rolled, a white blindfold round the neck, wading boots. Face: broad nose, heavy brow and lids, jowls, a dark beard shadow.

fennick.face: A small bald head on a long neck. A long fine nose with a hook, a wide thin mouth, raised white brows, high cheekbones.
fennick.full: The deacon: a white surplice to the knee with bell sleeves over black oilskins, a black stole, a glass bell jar under the arm. A small bald head on a long neck; long fine hooked nose, wide thin mouth, raised white brows, high cheekbones.

crake.face: A woman drawn without grotesque excess: a straight nose, a firm chin, level lids. Hair in a smooth grey roll.
crake.full: A woman all in one mid grey: a fitted grey coat to mid-calf, gloves, yellow-lensed spectacles, a fountain pen. Hair in a smooth grey roll; a straight nose, a firm chin, level lids.

merrow.face: A short wide man. A flat nose, a weathered face, a short beard.
merrow.full: Short and wide: a yellow oilskin smock, dark trousers wet to the thigh, a rope coil, a knitted cap, a cold pipe. Face: flat nose, weathered, short beard.

pip.face: A girl. Freckled, wide eyes, a quick mouth. Hair cropped, wild, tied back with string.
pip.full: A girl with long legs: a short skirt over boys' boots, an apron, a bodice, a shawl, a brass canister. Freckled, wide eyes, a quick mouth; wild cropped hair tied back.

fewell.face: A broad lamplighter with a heavy moustache.
fewell.full: A broad lamplighter: a long dark Municipal coat and cap, the pole carried on the shoulder, a pale bandage on the hand. A heavy moustache.

lugg.face: A very tall man. Face: long, mild, thin lips.
lugg.full: A very tall salvor, stooped as under rafters, very long arms: dark oilskins, a pale canvas sack slung, a crowbar, rope, a knitted cap. Face: long, mild, thin lips.

cockle.face: A very old woman. A nut of a face, a toothless smile.
cockle.full: A very old woman bent past twenty degrees, with a stick: men's sea boots, three skirts kilted up, a man's coat, a bucket, a white cap. A nut of a face, a toothless smile.

shadwell.face: A soot-black face with pale eye-rings.
shadwell.full: The smokehouse man: a leather apron black with soot, a shirt the colour of smoke, a pipe of black shag. A soot-black face with pale eye-rings.

spratt.face: A woman with a forward-thrust chin.
spratt.full: An eel-wife: an apron, oilcloth sleeves to the elbow, a headscarf, a string of eels over one shoulder, a gutting knife. A forward-thrust chin.

tobit.full: A choirboy: a white surplice over a jersey, too long; a candle.

dilly.face: A floor child, a small girl.
dilly.full: A small girl, a floor child: oversized boots, a lantern, a slate on a string round her neck.

gill.full: A boy runner: a long apron to the ankle with straps, a cap.

dunlin.face: An old captain with Marrow's build, older: a large old man.
dunlin.full: An old captain with Marrow's build: a captain's coat with buttons gone green, a blindfold slack round the neck, a peaked cap, a pipe.

rook.face: A woman with a long neck bent forward.
rook.full: A telegraphist: a long neck bent toward the sounder, pale sleeve protectors, a dark dress, a pencil in the hair.
